heroHeadline: European Leg Opens in Barcelona Tomorrow in 4 Days — 59 Weeks at No. 1, 32 Billion-Stream Songs; Bad Bunny's Stadium Era Comes to Europe
heroSubtitle: The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens its European stadium leg in four days at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, both nights sold out) — Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years and the crowning chapter of the most commercially dominant album cycle in Latin music history. 'DtMF' holds 59 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs (chart dated May 16, 2026), the longest run in the 60-plus-year history of the chart, extending the record Bad Bunny first broke on May 2 by surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's 'Despacito' at 56 weeks. His catalog simultaneously stands as the deepest billion-stream portfolio in Spotify history: 32 individual songs have crossed 1 billion streams — including 'Tarot' (feat. Jhayco) and 'Qué Pasaría…' (Rauw Alejandro feat. Bad Bunny), both of which crossed the threshold within the same 24-hour window last week — surpassing The Weeknd's 31 to give Bad Bunny the sole all-time record. The European run spans Barcelona, Madrid, and Brussels through July 22 at King Baudouin Stadium. Off-stage, the Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (Vivid Red, KI7916, $120) hits wide release via Adidas Confirmed on May 30 — twelve days from today — following its sold-out exclusive drop at All The Right NYC on May 15. Director Residente's Deadline interview confirmed *Porto Rico* principal photography expected to begin late 2026 in Puerto Rico, with Bad Bunny leading as revolutionary José Maldonado Román alongside Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem, executive produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu.
